claims.statement: On a declared complete finite representation fibre, deterministic action regret, epsilon-safe action sets, randomized minimax regret, and refinement monotonicity are exact under one common statewise oracle.
Minimum-cost static deterministic representation repair is weighted set cover on minimal action-conflict hyperedges; pairwise conflicts are insufficient for three or more actions.

State-dependent adaptive acquisition is exactly represented by statewise loss profiles or an equivalent offset Bellman state; a scalar recursion is universally exact exactly when acquisition charge is constant on each reached observation cell.

Separate learned and fallback marginal profile sets do not determine a deployed route. Exact route authority requires the legal joint profile language, deployed route observation, compatibility relation, common-oracle accounting, and acquisition timing.
On pinned SAT12-ALL, exhaustive evaluation of 513 dependency-closed representations selects {Pre,lobjois} with robust total excess 1712, versus 12000 for no features and 16906.55 for all features.
Exact equality fibres have very low held-out recurrence and poor decision value under official and family-held-out SAT12-ALL splits.
Marginal learned-action certificate calibration does not imply selective decision value when the fallback is worse on rejected states.
Under the prospectively frozen R18 protocol, zero of 99 MAXSAT12 development candidates is feasible and the least-bad paired marginal route changes zero decisions on MAXSAT12, MAXSAT19, and QBF-2016.
limitations: not a new prospective first result

claims.statement: The frozen SAT11-HAND-ALGO neighborhood/Lipschitz construction is not a valid unseen-state regret certificate under official or family-held-out evaluation.
limitations: does not refute empirical nearest-neighbor prediction

claims.statement: Exact finite-fibre certificates are closed-world objects; no inductive certificate follows from equality, marginal calibration, paired marginal calibration, or representation proximity without an independently justified structural law.
limitations: not a universal impossibility theorem for all statistical selectors
